scripts.firebase:preview: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy bootstrap --project nurture-12398 --expires 7d
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting --project nurture-12398
scripts.test:firestore-rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project nurture-12398 --only auth,firestore "node scripts/verify-firestore-rules.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore-backend: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project nurture-12398 --only firestore "node functions/scripts/verify-firestore-backend.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore-acceptance: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project nurture-12398 --only auth,firestore "node scripts/verify-firestore-rules.mjs && node functions/scripts/verify-firestore-backend.mjs"
